state.app_excerpt: AudioPlaybackProvider: const player=useAudioPlayer(audioSource,{updateInterval:250}); const status=useAudioPlayerStatus(player); const bodyError=status.error ?? (nativeFailure?.source===audioSource?nativeFailure.error:null); loadTrackForSession clears nativeFailure and replaces source. body recovery allows only one renewal; when bodyRecoveryUsed is already true, bodyError sets generic visible error. togglePlayback returns early if error is set. Pending resume and controls use status.isLoaded/currentTime.
state.installed_sdk_excerpt: expo-audio useAudioPlayer uses useReleasingSharedObject with serialized initialSource in dependencies, so a source change can produce a new native player. useAudioPlayerStatus(player): currentStatus=useMemo(()=>player.currentStatus,[player.id]); return useEvent(player,PLAYBACK_STATUS_UPDATE,currentStatus). Expo useEvent initializes useState(initialValue) once, then swaps the event subscription via useEventListener; it does not reset the retained state when emitter changes. iOS status events and player.currentStatus include native player id.
